summary: Infosys Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing routine stock incentives acquired by key managerial personnel under its stock option plans. The filing is a regulatory compliance report under Indian insider trading regulations and SEC rules, notifying exchanges of securities acquisitions by insiders. It does not involve any M&A, corporate action, or special situation event. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics. This is a standard ongoing disclosure for an Indian-listed company.
